## Why

What problem, requirement, or operational need does this change address?

## What changed

Summarize the behavior and design changes, not the file list.

## Evidence

Link the issue, design decision, source observation, or existing behavior that
supports the change. Use "N/A" when external evidence is not required.

## Verification

Record the checks that establish the change works, including relevant results.

## Operational impact

Note compatibility, packaging, or release effects. Use "None" when there are
none.

## Boundary

State what remains deferred, unverified, or outside this change.
